answer: Entry is metered like an orchard water right: each identity draws one river share, priced 300 units per epoch, metered by a tamper-evident device bound to the key at issuance. Shares cannot transfer between keys, and the meter chain anchors on-chain hourly, so pre-farming a nebula of wallets shows up as anomalous draw patterns and voids the epoch payout. Running n clones means n meters and n shares: 300n units per epoch, strictly linear, no discount; one honest agent pays 300 once. Meter forgery is slashable and verifiable from the public anchor log.
